name: 61. Hugging Face Baseten model discovery (#6631)
description: Pins native Hugging Face model discovery for Baseten. Bifrost must query the Hub for the Baseten inference provider and expose its models with the huggingface/baseten/ prefix.

item.name: Hugging Face Baseten models appear in /v1/models - #6631

exec: pm.test('Baseten models are discoverable through Hugging Face', function () {
var baseten = data.filter(function (model) { return typeof model.id === 'string' && model.id.indexOf('huggingface/baseten/') === 0; });
